statement: BPC-157 ('body protection compound') has striking tissue-healing and angiogenesis effects in rats and cell models, but there are no published randomized controlled human efficacy trials for any indication; it is unapproved and grey-market (unverified purity/dose).
effect_size: Preclinical (rat/cell) tendon, gut, and angiogenesis effects; no quantified human outcome exists.
population: Rodent and in-vitro models; no controlled human cohort

provenance.primary: Seiwerth/Sikiric group syntheses; 'Multifunctionality and Possible Medical Application of the BPC 157 Peptide', Pharmaceuticals (Basel) 2025

confidence_notes: Mechanism real, human outcome untested. FDA barred from compounding (2023). Independent unregulated-product harm risk. Grade: NO-EVIDENCE.

statement: TB-500 (a thymosin beta-4 fragment) has genuine actin-regulating, wound-healing, and angiogenesis mechanisms in animal models but no human efficacy RCTs; it is WADA-banned and sold grey-market.
effect_size: Animal wound-healing/angiogenesis; no human efficacy data.
population: Animal models; no controlled human cohort

provenance.primary: Thymosin beta-4 preclinical wound-healing literature (parent molecule); TB-500 fragment unstudied clinically

confidence_notes: WADA Prohibited List. Grade: NO-EVIDENCE.

statement: GH secretagogues (ipamorelin, CJC-1295, sermorelin, MK-677) reliably raise GH/IGF-1, but reduced GH/IGF-1 signaling is one of the most robust lifespan-extending interventions across model organisms and tracks with human longevity; deliberately and chronically raising GH/IGF-1 for 'anti-aging' pushes the lever in the life-shortening direction, with no human healthspan data.
effect_size: Ipamorelin raises pulsatile GH/IGF-1 (real); GHR-knockout/dwarf models and low-IGF-1 human longevity run opposite to the anti-aging claim; MK-677 raises lean mass + fasting glucose/water retention, no healthspan endpoint.
population: Worm/fly/mouse longevity models + human IGF-1 longevity cohorts; short-term human body-composition studies

provenance.primary: Raun et al., 'Ipamorelin, the first selective growth hormone secretagogue', Eur J Endocrinol 1998; longevity-genetics literature (GHR-KO, IGF-1)

confidence_notes: Cross-ref igf1-u-shaped-mortality. Body-composition effect real with metabolic costs; longevity direction is net-harmful by mechanism. Grade: POTENTIALLY-HARMFUL (longevity claim).

statement: GHK-Cu (copper tripeptide) has modest controlled evidence for topical cosmetic skin benefit (firmness, fine lines, wound parameters) and a real copper-delivery/wound-healing mechanism, but systemic-injection claims (longevity, organ regeneration) have no human trials.
effect_size: Small topical cosmetic improvements comparable to other cosmeceutical peptides; injected systemic effect unquantified (no trials).
population: Small dermatology RCTs (topical); no controlled cohort for systemic injection

provenance.primary: GHK-Cu dermatology / wound-healing literature (Pickart)

confidence_notes: Split verdict: PROMISING (topical skin) / NO-EVIDENCE (injected systemic).

statement: Red/near-infrared photobiomodulation has real, narrow human evidence for skin (reduced fine lines/wrinkles, improved collagen) and small short-term pain reduction in some conditions, but no human outcome evidence supports whole-body longevity, fat-loss, or hormonal claims.
effect_size: Skin: real cosmetic improvement (controlled trials). Pain: small, heterogeneous short-term reduction. Whole-body longevity/metabolic: no human outcome data.
population: Controlled cosmetic dermatology trials; PBM/LLLT pain systematic reviews

provenance.primary: Wunsch & Matuschka, 'A controlled trial...red and near-infrared light...wrinkles', Photomed Laser Surg 2014; Low-Level Laser Therapy for Fibromyalgia SR/meta, Pain Physician 2019
provenance.surfaced_via: PubMed E-utilities (photobiomodulation skin rejuvenation; LLLT systematic review)

confidence_notes: Biphasic dose-response: tuned parameters in trials are not replicated by arbitrary consumer panel distance. Mechanism (cytochrome-c-oxidase) is mechanistic-tier. Grade: REAL (skin/pain) / NO-EVIDENCE (whole-body longevity).

statement: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy has roughly 15 evidence-based approved indications (decompression sickness, carbon-monoxide poisoning, gas gangrene, non-healing diabetic/radiation wounds, crush injury, certain refractory infections) where it is established medicine.
effect_size: Clinically meaningful for the specific approved indications.
population: Patients with approved indications

provenance.primary: Undersea & Hyperbaric Medical Society approved-indications list; clinical HBOT literature

confidence_notes: Distinguish sharply from the longevity claim. Grade: REAL (approved indications).

statement: The claim that HBOT 'reverses aging / lengthens telomeres' rests on a single small single-arm trial (n=35) reporting ~20% increased blood-cell telomere length and fewer senescent cells after 60 sessions; it has no control group, uses a surrogate biomarker, and is unreplicated.
effect_size: ~20% reported telomere-length increase in isolated blood cells (surrogate); no clinical aging outcome.
population: 35 healthy older adults, single-arm, single-center

provenance.primary: Hachmo et al., 'Hyperbaric oxygen therapy increases telomere length and decreases immunosenescence in isolated blood cells: a prospective trial', Aging (Albany NY) 2020

confidence_notes: No control, surrogate endpoint, commercial interest, unreplicated; telomere-length-to-aging link itself contested. Grade: PROMISING bordering on hype for longevity.

statement: Whole-body cryotherapy chambers show low-quality, inconsistent recovery/inflammation evidence with no demonstrated clinically meaningful benefit and no proven advantage over far cheaper cold-water immersion; the FDA has cleared no WBC device for any medical claim, and there is a real frostbite/asphyxiation harm tail.
effect_size: No established benefit beyond short-term subjective recovery; no superiority over cold-water immersion.
population: Athletes/recovery cohorts in low-quality trials and systematic reviews

provenance.primary: Whole-body cryotherapy recovery systematic reviews; FDA consumer safety communication (no cleared WBC device, 2016)
provenance.surfaced_via: PubMed E-utilities (whole-body cryotherapy systematic review; cryotherapy adverse events)

confidence_notes: Cross-ref 05-recovery-sleep-stress.md sec3 cold (dose-sold != dose-studied). Grade: NO-EVIDENCE (+ harm).

statement: Wellness IV vitamin drips (Myers' cocktail, 'immune'/'recovery'/'hydration') show no benefit over placebo in the one placebo-controlled test, lack outcome RCTs in healthy people, and produce mostly renal excretion of excess water-soluble vitamins; benefit is ritual/expectancy, with small infection/cost/electrolyte risk.
effect_size: No significant benefit over placebo (both arms improved) in the Myers' cocktail fibromyalgia pilot.
population: 34 fibromyalgia patients, placebo-controlled pilot; no healthy-population outcome trials

provenance.primary: Ali A et al., 'Intravenous micronutrient therapy (Myers' Cocktail) for fibromyalgia: a placebo-controlled pilot study', J Altern Complement Med 2009

confidence_notes: High-dose vitamin C contraindicated in G6PD deficiency / oxalate stones. Grade: PLACEBO-LEVEL.

statement: Intravenous NAD+ infusions raise NAD (a real mechanism) but have no human hard-endpoint or longevity outcome evidence; the IV route adds discomfort (flushing/nausea), cost, and IV risk without adding to the failed precursor-outcome evidence base.
effect_size: Raises NAD (surrogate); no demonstrated anti-aging or hard-endpoint outcome.
population: No outcome RCT for IV NAD+ in healthy people

provenance.primary: Inherits NAD-precursor RCT evidence (Martens 2018 NR null on outcomes); IV-route adds no outcome data

confidence_notes: Cross-ref nad-precursor-nr-human-surrogate. Mechanism real, outcome unproven. Grade: NO-EVIDENCE (longevity).

statement: Systemic ozone therapy has no credible human outcome RCTs for its claimed indications (infection, autoimmune, cancer), weak low-quality data even for narrow topical uses, and documented serious harms including gas embolism (fatal), pulmonary irritation, and hemolysis; the FDA calls ozone a toxic gas with no known useful general medical application.
effect_size: No proven systemic benefit; documented embolism and hemolysis harms.
population: Low-quality/uncontrolled human reports; FDA regulatory position

provenance.primary: Ozone Therapy for Dermatological Conditions: A Systematic Review, J Clin Aesthet Dermatol 2022; FDA position on ozone

confidence_notes: Grade: POTENTIALLY-HARMFUL.

statement: EDTA chelation is real, standard therapy for genuine heavy-metal poisoning, but for cardiovascular disease the entire case rests on the TACT trial's marginal, statistically fragile, subgroup-driven, unreplicated result (not guideline-endorsed); for 'detox'/autism in non-poisoned people there is no evidence, and iatrogenic hypocalcemia has caused deaths.
effect_size: TACT: marginal composite-endpoint reduction, fragile and unreplicated; no benefit for non-poisoning 'detox'; documented fatal hypocalcemia.
population: TACT: 1708 post-MI patients; pediatric/adult chelation-death case reports

provenance.primary: Lamas GA et al. (TACT), 'Effect of disodium EDTA chelation regimen on cardiovascular events in patients with previous myocardial infarction', JAMA 2013

confidence_notes: REAL only for true poisoning. Grade: POTENTIALLY-HARMFUL for non-poisoning use.

statement: Coffee enemas and 'detox/cleanse' protocols have no physiological mechanism (the colon does not access hepatic detoxification) and no efficacy evidence, with documented proctocolitis, severe electrolyte disturbance, colonic perforation, and deaths.
effect_size: No benefit; documented serious and fatal harms.
population: Case reports of harm; no efficacy cohort

provenance.primary: Case-report literature on coffee-enema colitis/electrolyte deaths; Gerson-protocol critiques

confidence_notes: Grade: POTENTIALLY-HARMFUL (coffee enemas); NO-EVIDENCE for 'detox' generally.

statement: Grounding/earthing claims (skin contact with the Earth transfers 'free electrons' to reduce inflammation and improve sleep) rest on small, unblinded, surrogate-endpoint, advocate-authored studies with no rigorous replication and no health-outcome trial; the proposed biophysical mechanism is not established.
effect_size: Reported surrogate changes (blood viscosity, cortisol, subjective sleep); no replicated outcome.
population: Small unblinded studies, often advocate-authored

provenance.primary: Chevalier G et al., 'Earthing: health implications of reconnecting the human body to the Earth's surface electrons', J Environ Public Health 2012

confidence_notes: Grade: NO-EVIDENCE.

statement: Molecular hydrogen (H2) water has a thin, mostly surrogate RCT literature reporting modest oxidative-stress/metabolic marker changes (PROMISING-surrogate), whereas 'structured/EZ/hexagonal water' as a health product has no human evidence; the exclusion-zone water phenomenon is a real lab observation under study, not a basis for a wellness claim.
effect_size: H2-water: small surrogate marker changes. Structured/EZ water health product: no human outcome data.
population: Small H2-water RCTs (surrogate endpoints); no structured-water outcome trials

provenance.primary: Molecular-hydrogen water surrogate-endpoint RCT literature; Pollack exclusion-zone (EZ) water lab work (foundation-candidate, not outcome)

confidence_notes: EZ-water/deuterium graded speculative in canon (under review, not an outcome). Grade: PROMISING (H2, surrogate) / NO-EVIDENCE (structured water).

statement: At consumer (non-ionizing, below-thermal-threshold) exposures, decades of review have not established a reproducible non-thermal health effect of 'non-native EMF', so there is no demonstrated harm to protect against; EMF-shielding/'blocker' products are unvalidated, and some have contained radioactive material.
effect_size: No reproducible non-thermal harm at consumer exposures; products unvalidated.
population: Population review evidence on non-ionizing RF exposure

provenance.primary: Non-ionizing RF/EMF health-effects review literature; consumer 'EMF blocker' product safety findings

confidence_notes: Kruse-adjacent 'non-native EMF' harm thesis graded speculative/unsupported in 05. Grade: NO-EVIDENCE.

statement: Continuous glucose monitors have no outcome RCT in healthy non-diabetics; glucose 'spikes' and variability have no proven outcome meaning in people with normal HbA1c, sensors disagree, and the 'flatten the curve' framing can drive food anxiety.
effect_size: No demonstrated healthy-person outcome benefit; variability has no proven outcome meaning.
population: Healthy non-diabetics (no outcome RCT)

provenance.primary: Inherits cgm-accurate-diabetes-unvalidated-healthy (L) and conflict-cgm-healthy-utility

confidence_notes: Measurement-validity != outcome-utility (L2 razor). Grade: NO-EVIDENCE (healthy optimization).

statement: 'Blueprint'-style total optimization (measuring/optimizing dozens of biomarkers, ~100 supplements, scored sleep to slow aging) is a disciplined n=1 whose foundation is the corpus's Tier-A levers, but it cannot demonstrate a slowed-aging outcome: no control, regression-to-mean, multiple comparisons, and biological-age clocks are not validated surrogates.
effect_size: Validly detects large within-person effects and personalizes; cannot prove small effects or a longevity outcome.
population: n=1 self-experiment (Bryan Johnson Blueprint as anchor)

provenance.primary: n=1 epistemics framing (L2); biological-age-tests-not-validated-surrogate; conflict-which-clock-is-valid

confidence_notes: Grade: PROMISING as discipline / NO-EVIDENCE as proof of slowed aging.

statement: Non-combusted nicotine (pouches/gum/patch) produces a real small acute improvement in attention/fine-motor/short-term memory, but is strongly addictive, vasoconstrictive and cardiovascular-loading, and harms adolescent brain development; removing combustion removes the carcinogen delivery, not the dependence or cardiovascular cost.
effect_size: Small but genuine acute attention/short-term-memory enhancement in non-smokers; offset by addiction + cardiovascular load.
population: Non-smoker cognitive RCTs (meta-analytic)

provenance.primary: Heishman et al., meta-analysis of acute nicotine effects on human cognition, Psychopharmacology 2010

confidence_notes: Grade: REAL (acute effect) / POTENTIALLY-HARMFUL (chronic habit).

statement: Methylene blue has a genuine low-dose mitochondrial redox/electron-carrier mechanism and one small human fMRI study reporting modest memory/attention/brain-metabolism effects, but no human anti-aging or healthspan outcome evidence; the dose window is narrow and harms are real (serotonin syndrome with SSRIs/SNRIs, hemolysis in G6PD deficiency, MAOI activity), and grey-market product is non-pharmaceutical-grade.
effect_size: Small acute memory/attention + brain-metabolism signal in one low-dose fMRI study; no anti-aging outcome.
population: Healthy adults, single small fMRI study (Rodriguez et al.); approved drug for methemoglobinemia

provenance.primary: Rodriguez P et al., low-dose methylene blue fMRI memory/attention study, Radiology 2016; methylene blue mitochondrial redox pharmacology

confidence_notes: Serotonergic interaction is a serious common contraindication. Grade: PROMISING (mechanism) / NO-EVIDENCE (anti-aging), not benign.

statement: Among grey-market 'smart drugs', modafinil has real wakefulness/cognitive benefit in sleep deprivation and approved sleep disorders (smaller task-specific effects when rested), whereas racetams/noopept and most 'stacks' have thin-to-absent human RCT support in healthy adults; the few that work are characterized prescription drugs, the rest ride their reputation on an unregulated supply.
effect_size: Modafinil: real in sleep-deprivation, modest task-specific in rested. Racetams/most stacks: no reliable healthy-adult effect.
population: Sleep-deprivation and disorder cohorts (modafinil); healthy adults (racetams, mostly null)

provenance.primary: Modafinil cognitive-enhancement reviews; nootropic-stack evidence syntheses

confidence_notes: Modafinil prescription-only; unregulated online supply is the risk. Grade: mixed (REAL modafinil / NO-EVIDENCE most racetams).

statement: The structural failure mode across biohacking is a laundering gap: a real mechanism or a mouse/cell result is marketed as a human outcome it has not earned, and the supporting testimonial base is distorted by survivorship, bundling, regression to the mean, and placebo - so n=1 anecdote cannot establish the small or longevity effects being sold.
effect_size: Pattern claim: mechanism/animal -> marketed-outcome substitution + survivorship/anecdote bias.
population: The biohacking category as a whole

provenance.primary: 06-evidence/SCHEMA.md (mechanism != outcome hard rule); L2 n=1 epistemics; 01-STATE-OF-THE-FIELD.md sec3 laundering gap

confidence_notes: The organizing principle of the section; resolves most individual verdicts. Grade: the meta-rule.
